label: Hazard chain, modelled: the ensemble's median member (volume ×1, source Cv 0.2) routed down Lhende Khola → Bhote Koshi → Trishuli

run.note: 9 members (2763 ms), median member re-run to the end of its recession; the mass reaches the river 4.3 min after the collapse (13.0 km at 50 m/s); direct flow: 20.7 Mm³ of melt water, 25.9 Mm³ at Cv 0.20, peak 43260 m³/s as a debris-flow surge (peak 19 s after its front, over by 20 min)

observed.note: Flood at Rasuwagadhi ~08:40, about three minutes after the 08:37 seismic signal. 08:40 is also the time of the last NORMAL reading of the Bhote Koshi gauge (1.62 m against a 6 m warning level; DHM technical report) — 28 km of path and river in 3 min would be ~150 m/s, so this time is probably that gauge timestamp, not the flood.
observed.source: NDRRMA Situation Report #01 (1 Sep 2026); YAE/KU rapid report (31 Aug 2026); DHM FFD technical report via Onlinekhabar (27 Aug 2026)

observed.note: CCTV recorded floodwaters destroying the Gyirong Port complex at the Rasuwagadhi crossing ~08:44, seven minutes after the seismic signal (secondary source).
The same reconstruction: "~08:50, surge crosses at Rasuwagadhi-Timure and reaches Syabrubesi … in roughly ten minutes" (secondary source).
observed.source: S. Rauniyar, OPRI, "The Langtang Collapse" (3 Sep 2026)

observed.note: Syafrubesi ~09:00 in the same reconstruction (~10 min after Rasuwagadhi–Timure); secondary source.
observed.source: S. Rauniyar, OPRI, "The Langtang Collapse" (3 Sep 2026)

observed.note: The Bhotekoshi–Syafrubesi gauge read 1.62 m (normal; warning level 6 m) at 08:40 and its data stopped at 08:50. If the flood destroyed it, the front arrived between 08:40 and 08:50 and 08:50 is an upper bound; if its telemetry failed first (a link through the flooded valley above), 08:50 bounds nothing. Shown as 08:50.
observed.source: DHM Flood Forecasting Division technical report (27 Aug 2026), via Onlinekhabar; NDRRMA SitRep #01

observed.note: Flood at Betrawati ~09:20 — the time DHM station 447 (warning 4.1 m, danger 5.0 m) stopped transmitting; its last reading was 3.55 m, below warning. So 09:20 is when the gauge was lost, an upper bound on the front if the flood destroyed it.
observed.source: NDRRMA SitRep #01 (1 Sep 2026); DHM FFD technical report via Onlinekhabar (27 Aug 2026); DHM station 447 page (dhm.gov.np/hydrology/hms-Single/52)

observed.note: The surge reaches Betrawati ~09:00 in this reconstruction, against ~09:20 in NDRRMA SitRep #01 (secondary source).
